overview.about: The European Championships is a combined multi-sport event that stages the continental championships of several sports in a single city over a fortnight, sharing the audience and spotlight. Created in 2018, it groups athletics, swimming, cycling and more into one festival of European sport. Munich features in the 2026 edition.
overview.nextEvent: The next European Championships gather the European title events of multiple sports into one host city and broadcast window. It concentrates what were once separate championships into a single high-profile fortnight.

@graph.description: The 2022 European Championships combined several European sports championships in Munich from 11 to 21 August. Olympiapark Munich was a central competition setting, with athletics at the Olympic Stadium and other sports across the city. European Championships Management publishes the official history and multi-sport event information.
